payload.title: Design scalable context retrieval and semantic routing for DIP
payload.description: User proposes extending DIP beyond small-project Markdown comparisons to huge repositories with hundreds/thousands of documents. Current compactContext/task_next are bounded generic lists, not query-relevant retrieval. Proposed direction: canonical structured intent/events in .dip, derived local incremental lexical/vector indexes, graph/current-revision/status/scope filters, budgeted source-linked context packets per user intent, and semantic candidate triggers reviewed by the existing working agent. TurboVec is a candidate optional local vector backend (Rust/Python); it does not generate embeddings or determine authoritative project state. No engine installed and no semantic product feature implemented in this exploratory turn. Preserve zero model calls on routine capture; embedding work is explicit, asynchronous and optional rather than an extra chat model per tracking action.
acceptance: Retrieve current relevant requirements, decisions, dependencies, ownership and evidence within a fixed context budget, with source IDs and freshness reasons; do not select cancelled/superseded intent as authoritative due to semantic similarity.
Keep tracked .dip events canonical and indexes rebuildable/local; index only changed content and apply explicit invalidation/deletion on revisions, merges and cancellations.
Use a provider interface so lexical fallback works without embeddings/extra runtimes; evaluate TurboVec integration/platform/setup costs before choosing a mandatory backend.

Benchmark instructed Markdown search, structured lexical DIP and hybrid semantic DIP across increasing corpora with obsolete/conflicting documents. Measure relevant-current recall, stale-rule mistakes, final task correctness, tokens, latency and index maintenance cost; do not presume vectors improve quality.
Use semantic matches as candidates for links/conflicts/duplicate intent; require explicit agent mutation and real configured verification for state changes or verified completion.
